_note: Story progress flags (M9.1; DESIGN.md "Fixed opening cluster": the soft-gated path order). Each flag, once set, stays set, and is saved. The gates on the cluster's paths open on them (openingCluster.json "gates"), and dialogue lines can name them as conditions. trigger: what sets it (none: a story beat sets it in code, named in "about"). standIn: true = a stand-in until the real story beat (named in "about") sets it instead; those sessions should replace the trigger with their own setFlag() call. Trigger kinds: dusk (the first dusk on day `day`), dawn (any dawn once `after` are set), visit (Tom walks into the clearing `clearing`), all (as soon as `after` are set), cleared (Tom is in the clearing `clearing` and no living zombie is within `margin` metres of its edge), south (Tom is south of the cordon line). after: flags that must be set first.
